question: Top 10 parts by excess value (calculated_excess * unit_cost) for EOL parts
gold_sql: SELECT p.part_number, SUM(e.calculated_excess * p.unit_cost) AS excess_value FROM fact_excess_calculation e JOIN dim_part p ON p.part_id = e.part_id WHERE p.lifecycle_state = 'EOL' GROUP BY p.part_number ORDER BY excess_value DESC LIMIT 10

question: Show total excess value by supplier, top 10 suppliers
gold_sql: SELECT s.supplier_name, SUM(e.calculated_excess * p.unit_cost) AS v FROM fact_excess_calculation e JOIN dim_part p ON p.part_id = e.part_id JOIN dim_supplier s ON s.supplier_id = e.supplier_id GROUP BY s.supplier_name ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which commodities contribute most to excess value? show top 5 commodities
gold_sql: SELECT p.commodity, SUM(e.calculated_excess * p.unit_cost) AS v FROM fact_excess_calculation e JOIN dim_part p ON p.part_id = e.part_id GROUP BY p.commodity ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 5

question: List top 10 inventory positions by on hand quantity, include part number, location and supplier
gold_sql: SELECT p.part_number, i.location, s.supplier_name, i.on_hand_qty FROM fact_inventory i JOIN dim_part p ON p.part_id = i.part_id JOIN dim_supplier s ON s.supplier_id = i.supplier_id ORDER BY i.on_hand_qty DESC LIMIT 10

question: For each location, show total on hand and consigned quantity
gold_sql: SELECT location, SUM(on_hand_qty), SUM(consigned_qty) FROM fact_inventory GROUP BY location

question: Which 10 suppliers have the longest lead time?
gold_sql: SELECT supplier_name, lead_time_days FROM dim_supplier ORDER BY lead_time_days DESC LIMIT 10

question: Count parts by lifecycle state
gold_sql: SELECT lifecycle_state, COUNT(*) FROM dim_part GROUP BY lifecycle_state

question: List the 20 EOL part excess positions with the highest calculated excess
gold_sql: SELECT p.part_number, e.calculated_excess FROM fact_excess_calculation e JOIN dim_part p ON p.part_id = e.part_id WHERE p.lifecycle_state = 'EOL' ORDER BY e.calculated_excess DESC LIMIT 20

question: Show parts with an eol_date in the last 6 months (part_number, commodity, eol_date)
gold_sql: SELECT part_number, commodity, eol_date FROM dim_part WHERE eol_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months' AND eol_date <= CURRENT_DATE

question: Top 10 parts by total forecasted units
gold_sql: SELECT p.part_number, SUM(f.forecasted_units) AS u FROM fact_forecast f JOIN dim_part p ON p.part_id = f.part_id GROUP BY p.part_number ORDER BY u DESC LIMIT 10

question: Show the weekly forecast trend (total forecasted units per week)
gold_sql: SELECT forecast_week, SUM(forecasted_units) FROM fact_forecast GROUP BY forecast_week ORDER BY forecast_week

question: Compare total forecasted units by forecast type
gold_sql: SELECT forecast_type, SUM(forecasted_units) FROM fact_forecast GROUP BY forecast_type

question: Which 5 platforms have the largest BOM by number of distinct parts?
gold_sql: SELECT pl.platform_name, COUNT(DISTINCT b.part_id) AS n FROM fact_bom b JOIN dim_platform pl ON pl.platform_id = b.platform_id GROUP BY pl.platform_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many BOM lines are shared parts versus not shared?
gold_sql: SELECT is_shared, COUNT(*) FROM fact_bom GROUP BY is_shared

question: For the ServerY R750 platform, list the top 10 parts by qty_per_unit with part number
gold_sql: SELECT p.part_number, b.qty_per_unit FROM fact_bom b JOIN dim_platform pl ON pl.platform_id = b.platform_id JOIN dim_part p ON p.part_id = b.part_id WHERE pl.platform_name = 'ServerY R750' ORDER BY b.qty_per_unit DESC LIMIT 10

question: List the 20 most recent LTB orders with part_number, supplier_name, order_date and qty_ordered
gold_sql: SELECT p.part_number, s.supplier_name, l.order_date, l.qty_ordered FROM fact_ltb_orders l JOIN dim_part p ON p.part_id = l.part_id JOIN dim_supplier s ON s.supplier_id = l.supplier_id ORDER BY l.order_date DESC, l.ltb_id DESC LIMIT 20

question: Which 10 suppliers have the highest total quantity ordered in LTB orders?
gold_sql: SELECT s.supplier_name, SUM(l.qty_ordered) AS q FROM fact_ltb_orders l JOIN dim_supplier s ON s.supplier_id = l.supplier_id GROUP BY s.supplier_name ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 10

question: Show LTB orders with an expected delivery date within the next 90 days
Show scrap approval counts by status
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM fact_scrap_approval GROUP BY status

question: Top 10 highest scrap value approvals with part_number, scrap_qty, scrap_value and status
gold_sql: SELECT p.part_number, a.scrap_qty, a.scrap_value, a.status FROM fact_scrap_approval a JOIN dim_part p ON p.part_id = a.part_id ORDER BY a.scrap_value DESC LIMIT 10

question: Total scrap value by approver, top 10
gold_sql: SELECT gsm_approver, SUM(scrap_value) AS v FROM fact_scrap_approval GROUP BY gsm_approver ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 10

question: For each supplier country, show total calculated excess and total excess value
gold_sql: SELECT s.country, SUM(e.calculated_excess), SUM(e.calculated_excess * p.unit_cost) FROM fact_excess_calculation e JOIN dim_supplier s ON s.supplier_id = e.supplier_id JOIN dim_part p ON p.part_id = e.part_id GROUP BY s.country

question: Show consignment eligible excess positions with supplier name, calculated excess and scrap recommended
gold_sql: SELECT s.supplier_name, e.calculated_excess, e.scrap_recommended FROM fact_excess_calculation e JOIN dim_supplier s ON s.supplier_id = e.supplier_id WHERE e.consignment_eligible = TRUE ORDER BY e.calculated_excess DESC LIMIT 100

question: What is the on hand inventory value by commodity?
gold_sql: SELECT p.commodity, SUM(i.on_hand_qty * p.unit_cost) FROM fact_inventory i JOIN dim_part p ON p.part_id = i.part_id GROUP BY p.commodity

question: Show excess positions with negative calculated excess (if any)
gold_sql: SELECT * FROM fact_excess_calculation WHERE calculated_excess < 0

question: Which 5 locations have the highest total in-transit quantity?
gold_sql: SELECT location, SUM(in_transit_qty) AS q FROM fact_inventory GROUP BY location ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many platforms have an EOL date and how many BOM lines do they have?
gold_sql: SELECT pl.platform_name, COUNT(b.bom_id) FROM dim_platform pl JOIN fact_bom b ON b.platform_id = pl.platform_id WHERE pl.eol_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pl.platform_name
